checked: Last checked {date}. Prices and supported versions change, so check each tool's own site before you pay for anything.
disclosure: This page is written by the maker of Scout Reporter. The facts about other tools come from their own websites, linked below.

srWeb.name: Scout Reporter (website)
srWeb.platform: Any modern browser, including on macOS and Linux, with an existing CSV
srWeb.data: A CSV you export from FM with a Scout Reporter view; it never leaves your browser
srWeb.versions: FM27 uses FM View Exporter (Steam on Windows 10 or 11). FM26 uses BepInEx and a CSV export plugin.
srWeb.bestFor: Ranking an imported shortlist on FM27 role weights, projecting wonderkid potential, picking a Best XI within a budget, and analyzing squads and staff

srDesktop.name: Scout Reporter (Windows app)
srDesktop.data: Reads the running game: your FM player search, or the whole save
srDesktop.versions: FM27 (27.0) and FM26 (26.3), Steam, Epic or Game Pass
srDesktop.bestFor: The same screens as the website with real CA, PA and hidden attributes, and no export

genie.name: FM Genie Scout
genie.price: The public FM26 edition is free, and 26g became free on October 16, 2026. For FM27, 27g needs paid activation to show usable save data. A free FM27 edition is planned.
genie.data: Searches the player database in your FM save
genie.versions: FM26 26.0.0 to 26.3.2. Genie Scout 27g is in beta for FM27.
genie.bestFor: Searching the whole game database live, with a long track record since 2009

fmrte.name: FMRTE
fmrte.price: Scouting is free; saving edits needs a licence (FMRTE 27: €7.99 once, or a subscription)
fmrte.edits: Yes, that is its main job
fmrte.versions: Separate editions: FMRTE 27 for FM27, FMRTE 26 for FM26
fmrte.bestFor: Editing players, clubs and competitions while you play, plus searching the save

inGame.name: FM's own scouting
inGame.data: Your scouts' reports and the attributes your club knows
inGame.bestFor: Playing the game as intended, with attributes hidden until your scouts find them

databases.name: Online player databases
databases.data: The game's starting database, not your save
databases.bestFor: Looking players up before you start a save

hub.title: FM27 and FM26 scouting tools compared
hub.intro: The main ways to scout players in Football Manager 27 and 26, what each one needs and what it is best at.
hub.answer: For FM27 and FM26, Scout Reporter ranks players, projects wonderkid potential and builds a Best XI on a budget for free. Genie Scout searches your save on Windows. Genie Scout 26g became free on October 16, 2026. Genie Scout 27g requires paid activation to show usable save data, and a free FM27 edition is planned. FMRTE also scouts for free, with a licence for saving edits. FM’s own scouting uses your club’s reports.

choose.noInstall: Already have a CSV? Open it on the <link>Scout Reporter website</link> in a modern browser on Mac, Linux or Windows. The documented FM27 export uses Steam on Windows 10 or 11.
choose.live: For live scans, use <link>Scout Reporter for Windows</link>. Genie Scout also searches your FM save on Windows.
choose.edit: You want to change the game (attributes, finances, contracts): FMRTE. Scout Reporter and Genie Scout only read.
choose.mac: On a Mac, reading the game: FMRTE has a macOS version. Scout Reporter for Mac is planned.
choose.pure: No outside help at all: FM's own scouting.

genie.title: Scout Reporter vs Genie Scout
genie.intro: Compare edition pricing, platform requirements and scouting features for Football Manager 26 and 27.
genie.answer: Scout Reporter is free for FM26 and FM27. FM Scout made Genie Scout 26g free on October 16, 2026. Genie Scout 27g requires paid activation to show usable save data, and FM Scout plans a free FM27 edition. Genie Scout searches the player database in your save. Scout Reporter ranks players by role, projects wonderkid potential and helps build an XI within a budget.

stronger.history: A long track record: it has been made for every FM since 2009 and has a large user base.
stronger.search: Built for searching the whole game database, with many search filters in one window.
stronger.extras: The g edition adds role-rating search, Find Similar Players and a probability of development.
stronger.shortlist: Exports shortlists as a file you can import back into FM.

different.browser: The browser app opens an existing CSV on macOS, Linux or Windows. The documented FM27 export uses FM View Exporter with Steam on Windows 10 or 11. The live-scan desktop app runs only on Windows.
different.weights: Scores every player on FM27 benchmark role weights measured over 50,000 FM27 matches, or on your own weights, with S++ to F grades and vs Age for young players.
different.potential: Projects each attribute at full potential from CA and PA, not just one potential number.
different.team: Best XI within a transfer budget, squad analysis of your own team, and Best backroom for staff.
different.open: Free with no ads and no paid edition, the code is public on GitHub, and it is in 9 languages.

genie.both: They work well together: find players in Genie Scout or an FM player search, then rank the shortlist in Scout Reporter.

free.q: Is Scout Reporter a free alternative to Genie Scout?
free.a: Yes. The browser and Windows apps are free, with no ads or account. The browser app opens an existing CSV. The Windows app can scan the running FM26 or FM27 game.

fm27.q: Does Scout Reporter work with FM27?
fm27.a: Yes. The website reads FM27 and FM26 CSV exports, and the Windows app reads FM27 27.0 and FM26 26.3 directly. Its scoring and growth estimates are calibrated on FM27.

mac.q: Is there a Genie Scout for Mac?
mac.a: Genie Scout is for Windows. On Mac or Linux, Scout Reporter opens an existing CSV in the browser. Its live-scan desktop app is Windows-only.

fmrte.title: Scout Reporter vs FMRTE
fmrte.intro: A scouting and team-building tool next to a real-time editor that can also scout.
fmrte.answer: FMRTE is an editor: it changes players, clubs and competitions while you play, and its scouting is free while saving edits needs a licence. Scout Reporter never changes your game. It is a free analysis tool: scores on FM27 role weights, S++ to F grades, attributes projected at full potential, a Best XI within a budget, squad analysis and staff, in the browser from a CSV export or on Windows reading the game.

stronger.edit: Edits nearly anything in the save: attributes, contracts, finances, facilities, competitions.
stronger.platforms: Reads the game on Windows, macOS and Linux (and the Steam Deck in desktop mode).
stronger.stats: FMRTE 27 adds match stats with percentile radars and season grades, and a quick search that turns sentences into filters.

different.readOnly: Read-only by design: it cannot change your save, so it fits a save you want to keep honest.
different.free: Everything is free, with no licence or subscription.
different.weights: Scores on FM27 benchmark role weights measured over 50,000 FM27 matches, with grades and vs Age.
different.potential: Projects each attribute at full potential from CA and PA, and gives a development plan.
different.team: Best XI within a budget, squad analysis of your own team and Best backroom for staff.

fmrte.both: If you never edit, Scout Reporter covers scouting and team building for free. If you edit, FMRTE does that and Scout Reporter can still rank what you find.

cheat.q: Does Scout Reporter edit my save like FMRTE?
cheat.a: No. The website only reads a CSV you export, and the Windows app only reads the game's memory. Neither changes your game or your save.

price.q: Do I need to pay for FMRTE to scout?
price.a: According to FMRTE's site, scouting is free with no sign-up and a licence is only needed to save edits. Scout Reporter is free for everything.

mac.a: FMRTE has a macOS version that reads the game. Scout Reporter opens an existing CSV in a Mac browser. Its live-scan desktop app is Windows-only.
